segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: As you and Pip scrape your plates clean, and Titan licks his bowl so hard it slides across the rug like a curling stone, Granny walked out from the pantry carrying a steaming pewter platter.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: On the plate sat a dozen golden, perfectly baked holiday cookies dusted with sparkling sugar crystals.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip hopped onto the edge of his chair, adjusting his detective lapels.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Ahem! A splendid culinary display, Madame Grumble! But as an investigator of strict empirical discipline, I must inquire: what variety of cookie are we observing?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Granny laughed, a sound like little silver bells.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: They are whatever kind of cookie you want them to be, little fox.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip squinted with deep, comically pompous suspicion.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: A psychological illusion, no doubt. A trick of the mind! Very well, I shall put your confectionery claim to the test!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip puffed out his chest.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I declare that I desire a Chocolate Chip cookie!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip picked up a cookie, opened his snout wide, and took a big, crunchy bite.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His amber eyes rolled back into his furry head.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: GOOD SWEET GINGERBREAD! That is... that is mathematically, scientifically, the single greatest chocolate chip cookie in the history of the universe! The molten cacao! The brown sugar ratio! It is a masterpiece!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip began chewing with furious delight.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: As he chewed, his eyes drifted toward the crackling fireplace.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Though... now that I reflect upon the winter season... gingerbread has always been the superior festive biscuit. A touch of molasses, a bite of clove...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: FLASH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Right inside Pip’s mouth, a tiny puff of golden cinnamon sparkles puffed out of his nostrils!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip’s jaw froze mid-chew. His ears shot straight up like two radio antennas.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: WHA—?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip gasped, his eyes bulging.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: MY CHOCOLATE CHIP JUST WENT CLOVE! IT'S WARM! IT'S SPICY! IT TURNED INTO GINGERBREAD IN THE MIDDLE OF MY TEETH! MADAME, YOUR BAKING IS DEFYING THE LAWS OF THERMODYNAMICS!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Granny winked at you.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Go on, sweetheart. Try yours.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You pick up a warm, sugar-dusted cookie. As you lift it to your mouth, you're still thinking about Pip's gingerbread.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You take a bite—and the rich, sweet warmth of ginger and molasses explodes across your tongue, crunchy on the edges and soft in the middle.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Wow, you think, savoring the flavor. This would be amazing with a mug of hot chocolate.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: POOF.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Instantly, the center of the cookie turns into a warm, creamy, velvety pocket of rich melted marshmallow and molten hot cocoa, coating your mouth in sweet, silky chocolate!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You laugh out loud, your eyes wide with pure wonder.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It really is magic!
